question: Estimate the cost of setting up a quick commerce dark store.
idealClarificationQuestions: Single dark store setup capex (one-time)? Yes.
Excludes ongoing rent + inventory + staff? Yes — one-time setup capex only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total capex per dark store: ~₹30-40 lakh (excl. inventory).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: All-in launch cost per dark store: ~₹60-90 lakh.

calculationFlow: - Civil + interior fit-out (racks, lighting, flooring): ~₹15-20 lakh.
- Tech infrastructure (POS, cameras, network, WiFi): ~₹3-4 lakh.
- Inventory (initial fill): ~₹15-20 lakh (working capital, not strict capex).
Total capex per dark store: ~₹30-40 lakh (excl. inventory).
Plus security deposit for rented space (~6-12 months rent): ~₹15-30 lakh.
All-in launch cost per dark store: ~₹60-90 lakh.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: All-in launch cost per dark store: ~₹60-90 lakh.
